title: Remote Rowhammer Attack using Adversarial Observations on Federated Learning Clients
abstract: arXiv:2505.06335v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) has the potential for simultaneous global learning amongst a large number of parallel agents, enabling emerging AI systems to be trained across demographically diverse data. Central to this being efficient is the ability for FL to perform sparse gradient updates and remote direct memory access at the central server. Most of the research in FL security focuses on protecting data privacy at the edge client or in the communication channels between the client and server. Client-facing attacks on the server are less well investigated as the assumption is that a large collective of clients offer resilience. Here, for the first time, we show that by attacking clients that lead to repetitive clustered memory updates in the server, we can remote initiate a rowhammer attack to corrupt the server memory with induced bit-flips. translated_title: 基于联邦学习客户端对抗性观测的远程Rowhammer攻击
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）具有在大量并行智能体之间实现同步全局学习的潜力，使新兴的人工智能系统能够在人口统计多样化的数据上进行训练。实现高效训练的关键在于联邦学习能够在中央服务器上执行稀疏梯度更新和远程直接内存访问。现有大多数联邦学习安全研究侧重于保护边缘客户端或客户端与服务器之间通信通道的数据隐私。而面向客户端针对服务器的攻击则研究较少，因为人们普遍认为大量客户端的集体行为能够提供抗攻击韧性。在此，我们首次证明，通过攻击客户端从而在服务器中引发重复性的聚簇内存更新，攻击者可以远程发起Rowhammer攻击，通过诱导位翻转来破坏服务器内存。一个无需服务器后门访问权限的强化学习（RL）攻击者可以学会如何……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究首次揭示了针对联邦学习服务器的新型远程Rowhammer攻击：攻击者利用强化学习智能体在客户端生成对抗性观测，引发服务器重复性的聚簇内存更新，从而在无需后门权限的情况下通过位翻转远程破坏服务器内存。
en_tdlr: This work demonstrates the first remote Rowhammer attack on federated learning servers, where a reinforcement learning attacker on clients crafts adversarial observations to induce repetitive clustered memory updates and corrupt server memory via bit-flips, all without backdoor access to the server.
